name: June
summary: Summer begins — daily operation everywhere, full water parks, and the first sustained crowds, with the northern parks hit hardest as their school years end.

verdict.short: June at these parks: a good window with known trade-offs. Summer begins.
bestFor: Daily operation at the northern parks

crowds.shape: Summer begins — daily operation everywhere, full water parks, and the first sustained crowds, with the northern parks hit hardest as their school years end.
peakWindows: The last two weeks as every district is out
quietWindows: The first week, while some schools remain in session

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: The June crowd curve is a staircase — each week another district empties in. The first week is a secret shoulder season; the last is full summer.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: Texas and Florida afternoons begin the storm pattern; the morning-first plan stops being advice and becomes the plan.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
